about_short_description.short_description: Decapolis is an information technology company that provides technology to create production and distribution chain for food products.

product.name: Decapolis Food Guard (DFG)
product.description: A blockchain-based end-to-end traceability solution for food safety and quality assurance across production and supply chains.

product.name: Decapolis Blockchain Platform
product.description: A distributed ledger system using blockchain technology to secure, timestamp, and verify data for transparency and authenticity in food supply chains.

product.name: FSMA Section 204 Compliance Solution
product.description: A solution enabling food producers and supply chain stakeholders to comply with FDA FSMA Section 204 traceability and recordkeeping requirements.

product.name: Smallholder Farmer Traceability Platform
product.description: A blockchain-based platform that enables smallholder farmers to validate product quality and compliance, improving market access and income.
